description: This file contains JavaScript functions for handling mouse events, including tracking mouse movements, button presses, wheel events, and enabling mouse button interactions within a web application.

methods.name: trackMouseEvents
methods.description: Sets up event listeners on a mouse element to track mouse down, up, and move events, and sends corresponding data through the provided data channel object.

methods.name: enableMouseButton
methods.description: Enables mouse button interactions by setting up event listeners for key and wheel events on a button element, and initiates mouse tracking.
